column4: S4.7: Sound_setName (the 0x100-byte stack buffer, 0x1cf16-0x1cfc8) and SoundTimer::onTick (the 0x100-byte message buffer passed to sprintf and OutputDebugStringA, 0x8f67-0x8f7f) pass the address of a stack buffer. The port has no stack in the context's address space, so both use the 16 cells 0..15 of `fcell` (16 bytes each, base = image end - 0x4e0). The padding after .reloc is only 0x2ee bytes (.reloc ends at rva 0xbdd12, SizeOfImage 0xbe000) and audio_seq / audio_chan use all of it, so this band lies in the tail of .reloc data (never read after the loader applied it; the oracle compares fixture regions only). The two functions are never on one call chain, so they share the cells. ALL stack locals of the module sit behind this one helper.

column4: S4.7: negative-control mode 2 of Sound5b6a8_ctor (every x87 operation as a plain double operation) is BLIND on the C3 vectors at both control words (Win32 replay: 3 of 3 vectors pass at 0x027f and at 0x0f7f, log/roadmap/S4/7_x87ctl.tsv). Cause: the constructor seeds its tempo fields (+0x728, +0x720) from constants and from fields it has just cleared, so no vector input reaches the arithmetic, and the emulated original itself returns the same bits at both words (S4.1 log/roadmap/S4/1_x87_cw.tsv: BLIND, emu_rows_changed 0). The port runs the original's x87 instruction sequence on Win32 (X80 helpers) and equals the emulator at both words, so the correct body is judged; only the control cannot separate a plain-double body.

column4: S4.7: S4.1's fake WINMM has no timeGetTime (`'winmm.dll': {}` in re/tools/fixvm/syslibs.js), so 4 of the 12 vectors of getPlaybackTime stopped in the emulator (S4.1 tier PARTIAL_ERR, my first oracle run RED 8/12). The shared file is not edited: 7_run.py runs the keys in CLOCK_KEYS on a copy of the VM whose WINMM answers timeGetTime with the constant 0x1234 (both arms see it). The C3 fixture chooses every vector's anchor and limit so that the result does not depend on the clock (re/frida/registry.d/c3cl.py header: anchor 0x80000000 with limit 0x7fffffff, anchor 1 with limit 0xfffffff0), so a constant is a valid clock. Result: 12 of 12 vectors GREEN in three layouts, tier EQUAL_PI against the C3 CSV (the S4.1 census tier was PARTIAL_ERR). The coverage run 7_cover.py uses the plain VM, so its table shows getPlaybackTime at 22 of 30 instructions (0x2bac1-0x2bad3 are reached only with the clock).
